purpose: Teach: 州立/施主/廻っ/下層/席上/呼応/デマンド/無休

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、州立大学での防犯講演もされますね
lines.en: You give crime prevention talks at state universities too, right?
lines.style: Steady, curious. Warm acknowledgment of the work being discussed. Light upward lilt on the question—seeking confirmation, not challenging. Respectful distance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、建築現場の施主との連絡もされますね
lines.en: You also coordinate with site owners at construction projects, right?
lines.style: Same curious warmth. Slight nod in the voice—following along a list of responsibilities. Easy, conversational pace. Genuinely interested in the scope of the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、管轄区域を廻って巡回されますね
lines.en: You patrol around your jurisdiction area regularly, don't you?
lines.style: Continued steady rhythm. Warm but grounded—acknowledging practical, hands-on work. Slight emphasis on 'regularly' without judgment. The tone of someone learning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、社会下層の防犯支援もされますね
lines.en: You provide crime prevention support to communities that need it most, right?
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment of the social care aspect. Warm and sincere—the tone shifts slightly to honor the work's human dimension. Still questioning, but with quiet respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査会議の席上で報告されますね
lines.en: You report on findings at investigation meetings too?
lines.style: Moving back to procedural observations. Steady, matter-of-fact. The tone of someone tracking the full picture of police work. Alert but not skeptical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民通報に呼応した出動もされますね
lines.en: You respond to citizen reports as they come in, of course.
lines.style: Simple acknowledgment. The recognition of the reactive, urgent side of the work. Tone straightens slightly—grounded, factual. Understanding the weight of that responsibility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯デマンドを分析されますね
lines.en: You analyze demand patterns for crime prevention measures?
lines.style: Data-oriented question. Curious about the analytical layer. Lighter tone than previous lines—intellectual interest. Still warm, still collaborative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察署は実質無休で対応されますね
lines.en: And your station really does operate essentially without a day off, doesn't it?
lines.style: Gentle landing—slight heaviness in recognition of the toll. Quieter, more measured. The voice that knows this is the reality of the work. Respectful, not pitying.
